grades.name: Arab Super Light
grades.note: The lightest of the five Saudi grades. Saudi Aramco defines it as API gravity above 40° with sulfur below 0.5%. It makes up about 1% of Saudi crude reserves.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; EIA Country Analysis Brief: Saudi Arabia (2024)

grades.name: Arab Extra Light
grades.note: Blended from the Abqaiq, Berri and Shaybah fields. Saudi Aramco defines the grade as API gravity 37° to 40° with sulfur 0.5% to 1.3%.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; EIA Country Analysis Brief: Saudi Arabia (2024)

grades.name: Arab Light
grades.note: Mostly from the Ghawar field. Saudi Aramco defines the grade as API gravity 32° to 36° with sulfur 1.3% to 2.2%. It makes up about a third of Saudi crude reserves.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; EIA Country Analysis Brief: Saudi Arabia (2024)

grades.name: Arab Medium
grades.note: Produced from offshore fields including Zuluf and Marjan. Saudi Aramco defines the grade as API gravity 29° to 32° with sulfur 2.2% to 2.9%.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; EIA Country Analysis Brief: Saudi Arabia (2024)

grades.name: Arab Heavy
grades.note: Produced mainly from the offshore Safaniya field. Saudi Aramco defines the grade as API gravity below 29° with sulfur above 2.9%.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; EIA Country Analysis Brief: Saudi Arabia (2024)

grades.name: Iranian Light
grades.note: Exported from Kharg Island, Iran's main crude terminal.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products

grades.name: Iranian Heavy
grades.note: Exported from Kharg Island, Iran's main crude terminal.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products

grades.name: Foroozan Blend
grades.note: A blend exported from Kharg Island. It takes its name from the offshore Foroozan field.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products

grades.name: Basrah Light
grades.note: A southern Iraqi grade. Its specification was reset on 1 January 2021, when Basrah Medium was added as a third southern grade.
grades.source: S&P Global (2020)

grades.name: Basrah Medium
grades.note: Introduced on 1 January 2021 as a third southern export grade. With Basrah Heavy, it made up the exports from Iraq's southern Gulf terminals in 2024.
grades.source: S&P Global (2020); EIA Country Analysis Brief: Iraq (2025)

grades.name: Basrah Heavy
grades.note: The heaviest and most sulfurous grade in this table. Exported from Iraq's southern Gulf terminals.
grades.source: S&P Global (2020)

grades.name: Kirkuk
grades.note: The northern Iraqi grade, from the Kirkuk area. It is exported through the Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline to Turkey's Mediterranean coast. That line was shut from March 2023 until late September 2025.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; EIA Country Analysis Brief: Iraq (2025)

grades.name: Kuwait Export
grades.note: Kuwait's main export grade, a medium sour crude produced mainly from the Burgan field.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; EIA Country Analysis Brief: Kuwait (2023)

grades.name: Murban
grades.note: Abu Dhabi's main onshore grade. It loads at Jebel Dhanna and is also piped to Fujairah, outside the Strait of Hormuz.
grades.source: EIA Country Analysis Brief: United Arab Emirates (2026)

grades.name: Upper Zakum
grades.note: From the offshore Upper Zakum field. It loads at Zirku Island.
grades.source: EIA Country Analysis Brief: United Arab Emirates (2026)

grades.name: Das
grades.note: An offshore Abu Dhabi grade, named after Das Island.
grades.source: EIA Country Analysis Brief: United Arab Emirates (2026)

grades.name: Umm Lulu
grades.note: An offshore Abu Dhabi grade from the Umm Al Lulu field.
grades.source: EIA Country Analysis Brief: United Arab Emirates (2026)

grades.name: Qatar Marine
grades.note: Qatar's offshore grade, from fields such as Idd El Shargi, Maydan Mahzam and Bul Hanine. It is exported from Halul Island.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; QatarEnergy

grades.name: Qatar Land
grades.note: Qatar's onshore grade, from the Dukhan field. It is exported from Mesaieed.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; QatarEnergy

grades.name: Oman Export
grades.note: Oman's export blend, loaded at Mina al Fahal near Muscat.
grades.source: BP crude assay (2020)

grades.name: Marib Light
grades.note: Yemen's light, sweet stream, from the Marib area. Before the war it was piped to the Ras Isa terminal on the Red Sea.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; EIA Country Analysis Brief: Yemen (2020)

grades.name: Masila
grades.note: Yemen's medium-gravity stream, with more sulfur than Marib Light, from the Masila Basin. It is exported from the Ash Shihr terminal on the Gulf of Aden.
grades.source: Wikipedia: List of crude oil products; EIA Country Analysis Brief: Yemen (2020)
